construction: All values invented directly; bases plus explicit mutations are synthetic fixtures, not recorded live payloads.
mutation_semantics: JSON Pointer path; set replaces/adds object property or existing array element; remove deletes property/array element; no network or runtime transformations.
schema_layer_note: Declared-shape validity is distinct from acceptance validity and semantic check outcome. Evidence class describes construction, not a claim of live verification.
